input.summary: Carve express warranties out of the AS IS disclaimer and add an affirmative performance/conformance warranty with a repair, replace or refund remedy.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Licensed Technology is currently supplied wholly "AS IS" with every express and implied warranty disclaimed, so we have no contractual recourse if the Platform fails to work as documented. We have added a standard performance and conformance warranty (12 months for software, professional and workmanlike services, no malicious code, compliance with law) with a repair, replace or refund remedy, and carved it out of the disclaimer. If a shorter period is needed we can accept 90 days for the software and 30 days for the support services with the same remedies.
